_comment: Classes, map locations and cities for school profiles, each citing the page it was read from (2026-10-25). Classes come from the school's own website, quoted in the note; where a site gives only the entry class, the highest class comes from a second official statement (Class XII results on the site, or the CBSE SARAS affiliation level) and the note says so. Locations are OpenStreetMap objects whose name and address matched the profile; a match was rejected when the name or address disagreed (Mayo College, Boys' High School and College, CMS Kanpur Road). Schools whose sites state no class range (The Scindia School, Bishop Westcott Boys' School, Netarhat Awasiya Vidyalaya, Pathways World School) have no classes here. Entries are SchoolFactsRequest bodies for PATCH /api/v1/admin/schools/{id}/facts, keyed by slug. Load with LocalFactsImport (development) or tools/seed/import-to-server.js.
